headlines.title: Renee Good’s family sues U.S. government, ICE officer and Trump officials
headlines.description: The family of Renee Good has filed two federal civil lawsuits alleging wrongful death and excessive force, their attorney announced, nine months after an immigration officer fatally shot her in Minneapolis. NBC News' Shaquille Brewster explains the details of both civil suits.

headlines.title: Supreme Court to decide lawfulness of Trump’s immigrant detention policy
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Supreme Court said Thursday it will consider whether immigrants subject to deportation can be held in detention indefinitely while their cases are adjudicated.

headlines.title: Death Row Inmate Survives Botched Execution in Tennessee
headlines.description: A woman on Tennessee’s death row is still alive after two attempts at lethal injections. It’s the second time this year that Tennessee has botched an execution and now all future ones have been halted by the state’s governor. NBC’s Jesse Kirsch reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Diddy placed in solitary following NBC News report on his VIP prison life
headlines.description: Sean “Diddy” Combs has been placed in solitary confinement following an NBC News report on his VIP lifestyle inside prison.

headlines.title: New Details Emerge in Attempted Hijack on Israel-Bound Plane
headlines.description: New details about the pilot stabbing on a flight headed to Israel reveal the plane plummeted thousands of feet before passengers managed to take control. Senior Israeli and Saudi Officials briefed on the investigation saying the attack increasingly looks like an act of terrorism. NBC’s Matt Bradley reports and Tom Winter, who covers law and intelligence, joins TODAY with analysis on the investigation.

headlines.title: What we know about the pilot hailed as a hero for averting crash of Israel-bound plane
headlines.description: He is being hailed around the world as a hero for helping stop a passenger plane bound for Israel from plunging into the ground, despite his own severe injuries.

headlines.title: Screaming, panicking, blood: Passengers detail horrifying Israel-bound flight
headlines.description: TEL AVIV — A stabbing, an emergency alert, a terrifying mid-air plunge.

headlines.title: How 16 undecided voters are weighing their 2026 election options
headlines.description: The voters, who participated in a recent NBC News poll and spoke to reporters afterward, are laser-focused on high prices and largely disappointed with both parties.

headlines.title: Judge bars U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro from charging ex-Olympian in Reflecting Pool case
headlines.description: A D.C. Superior Court judge has permanently banned Jeanine Pirro’s office from bringing charges against a former Olympic canoeist over damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

headlines.title: New legislation aims to block renaming aircraft carrier after Trump
headlines.description: Sen. Cory Booker is trying to stop the Pentagon from naming an aircraft carrier after Donald Trump instead of a Black war hero from the 1940s.

headlines.title: For the same ticket on StubHub, different prices for different people
headlines.description: NBC News volunteers saw eight different prices for the exact same Harry Styles ticket on StubHub. The company said it’s running random price experiments.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
